title: Bad Request
causes: The request contains invalid data, malformed JSON, missing required fields, or incorrect parameters.
steps: Check that the request body contains valid JSON.
Verify required fields and parameter names.
Check the API documentation for the expected request format.

title: Unauthorized
causes: Authentication credentials are missing, invalid, or expired.
steps: Check whether the API requires an API key or access token.
Verify the Authorization header format.
Confirm that the credentials are valid and have not expired.

title: Forbidden
causes: The server understood the request but refuses access because the user or credentials lack permission.
steps: Check account permissions and access policies.
Verify that the API key has the required permissions.
Check whether the endpoint requires a particular subscription or role.

title: Not Found
causes: The requested endpoint or resource does not exist at the specified URL.
steps: Check the URL path for spelling mistakes.
Verify the resource ID exists.
Confirm the endpoint and HTTP method in the API documentation.

title: Too Many Requests
causes: The client has exceeded the API rate limit or request quota.
steps: Check the API rate-limit and quota policies.
Wait before retrying.
Use exponential backoff and respect the Retry-After header when provided.

title: Internal Server Error
causes: The server encountered an unexpected condition while processing the request.
steps: Check the response body for additional error details.
Retry after a short delay if appropriate.
If you manage the API, inspect server logs and exception traces.

title: Bad Gateway
causes: A gateway or proxy received an invalid response from an upstream server.
steps: Check whether the upstream API service is available.
Retry after a short delay.
If you manage the infrastructure, inspect gateway and upstream server logs.

title: Service Unavailable
causes: The server is temporarily unavailable, overloaded, or undergoing maintenance.
steps: Check the API provider's service status.
Retry after a short delay.
Use backoff between retries instead of sending repeated requests.
